constraints: Keep the base image, Compose image, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use phpmyadmin on one supported phpMyAdmin release line.
Confirm the application and its data or configuration work on the target phpMyAdmin release; read the vendor's upgrade notes before moving across several release lines.

steps.instructions: Change the reported FROM line or Compose image to a tag on a supported release line, and pin it to a digest if your policy requires.
steps.title: Update the base image

steps.instructions: Update other Dockerfiles, Compose files, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use the same image so they agree.
steps.title: Align other image references

verification.purpose: Build the image on the new base.
Confirm the container starts on the new base.

rules.replacement: A phpmyadmin image on a supported release line

sources.title: phpMyAdmin downloads and version support policy

rules.summary: These phpMyAdmin release lines are unsupported: the vendor's downloads page supports only the current stable line and the 4.9 LTS line, and says older releases are unsupported.
rules.title: phpMyAdmin image release lines 4.8 and older are end-of-life
